data.name: Shubham Deokate
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Shubham Deokate has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 82, with an average of 16.00 and a quick strike rate of 144.14. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 9 sixes and 16 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.3 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 8.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
